Context: 9. Gratuity

This gratuity is in addition to retirement gratuity admissible to those who have completed 5 years qualifying service. - Rule 45 (1).  
2. Retirement Gratuity is admissible to all employees who retire after completion of 5 years of qualifying service at the rate of 'one-fourth' of emoluments for each completed six-monthly period of qualifying service  
subject to a maximum of 16 Yi times 'the emoluments' or t 20 lakhs from 1-1-2016.
